product.name: Basedash Business Intelligence Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that connects directly to databases or data warehouses to create dashboards, charts, and insights without requiring SQL knowledge.

product.name: Basedash Warehouse
product.description: A managed data warehouse service built on ClickHouse that automatically sets up a warehouse for users to visualize and analyze data without impacting production databases.

product.name: SQL Query Editor
product.description: A multiplayer SQL editor with features like auto-formatting, variables, version history, and autocompletion for writing and managing SQL queries collaboratively.

product.name: Table Explorer
product.description: A spreadsheet-like interface that allows users to explore and interact with their database tables without needing technical expertise.

product.name: Natural Language Data Chat
product.description: A feature that allows users to query and interact with their data using natural language, generating charts and insights without SQL knowledge.
